title: Score Attack
gameplaySummary: What Makes It Unique Score Attack must be different from every other mode in these ways: Score Attack must be different from every other mode in these ways: unlike Combo Rush, score is primary and combo is only supportive, not the entire economyunlike Clear Rush, clearing the board is not the main goalunlike Color Hunt, there is no restricted target color objectiveunlike Tile Shift, the challenge is not board rearrangementunlike Number Crunch, solving is not arithmetic-firstunlike Link Lock / Circuit Clash / Pipe Pulse, the player is not constructing persistent routesunlike Memory Flash / Glyph Rush, the challenge is not recallunlike RuleBreaker, the rules do not mutate mid-match unlike Combo Rush, score is primary and combo is only supportive, not the entire economy | Win: Win Condition A player wins by: A player wins by: | Players: 4

pieces.name: Standard Gem
pieces.notes: 6 color variants, each with matching states. Core match mechanic pieces.

pieces.name: Special Gem
pieces.notes: Special piece types earned via combos. Must be visually distinct from standard.

pieces.name: Blocker Tile
pieces.notes: Non-matchable obstruction. Requires hit to clear.

mechanics.name: Gem Swap
mechanics.description: Player swaps adjacent gems to form matches.

mechanics.name: Cascade Fill
mechanics.description: Gems fall to fill cleared spaces; may trigger chain matches.

mechanics.name: Combo Chain
mechanics.description: Sequential matches trigger escalating combo bonuses.

mechanics.name: Board Danger
mechanics.description: Unmatched build-up darkens the board and threatens overflow.

effects.notes: Escalating burst per combo count. Bigger and brighter at higher combos.
Looping danger overlay darkening board edges.
Dramatic clear sweep across row/column or explosion radius.

spriteSheets.phaserUsage: spritesheet per color variant; individual animations per state
spriteSheets.styleNotes: Each row = 1 color variant (cyan, magenta, amber, green, red, neutral). Strong gem silhouette with faceted surface. Bright inner glow per color. Match flash = white-burst then color explosion. Selected state = gem enlarges slightly with ring outline.
spriteSheets.gameplayReadabilityNotes: Color variants must remain distinguishable even at small sizes (64px). No two variants similar in hue.

spriteSheets.phaserUsage: played once at match location, tinted per gem color
spriteSheets.styleNotes: Neutral white-cyan burst designed to be color-tinted at runtime. Crystal shatter + energy burst. Brief and punchy.
spriteSheets.gameplayReadabilityNotes: Burst must complete before next player action registers. No persistent smoke.

spriteSheets.phaserUsage: looped overlay applied to board edges when danger threshold reached
spriteSheets.styleNotes: Dark red vignette that pulses inward. Edge-only, transparent center. Unsettling but not blinding.
spriteSheets.gameplayReadabilityNotes: Center of board must remain fully playable — no center tinting.
